confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Shenzhen pricing, not checked against live venues or listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the most reliable; hotel rates and cocktail prices are less certain and vary widely by district and venue type. Values assume a CNY-to-USD rate near 7.1 and may drift for July 2026. The FX observation was taken from a search summary of the RBA overview page, not from the F11 table itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other tier-1 mainland Chinese cities, mainly Guangzhou and Shanghai, with Shenzhen priced close to Guangzhou for food and accommodation and slightly higher for cafés and bars.
